response.justification: While Bogdan demonstrates strong foundational skills as a staff-level engineer with TypeScript expertise and is actively engaged in AI-agent infrastructure and MCP framework development at re:cinq, he falls significantly short of core requirements. The absence of Python experience is concerning for an AI-focused role, and his 16 months of GenAI-specific experience is substantially below the required 8+ years. His current work with agentic workflows and demonstrated leadership suggest potential, but additional depth in LLM systems, vector databases, and RAG architectures needs to be established.
strengths: Staff-level engineering background with proven mentoring and technical leadership across multiple organizations
Active hands-on experience building AI-agent infrastructure and MCP (Model Context Protocol) frameworks at re:cinq
Strong TypeScript/Node.js proficiency and AWS cloud platform expertise including CDK and Kubernetes deployment experience
concerns: No Python experience mentioned despite it being a primary required language for AI/ML and GenAI development
Only 16 months of GenAI-specific experience versus the required 8+ years developing AI-driven production solutions
No demonstrated expertise with vector databases, RAG architectures, multi-agent frameworks, or LLM performance optimization

key_factors.factor: GenAI experience depth gap (16 months vs. 8+ years required)
Current active work on agentic workflows and MCP frameworks
